notes.title: 🐾Demo Update + Festival News! 🐾
notes.notes:
Hello pupventurers!

We’re excited to share some big news about Donna: The Canine Quest!

✨ Demo Update
The demo has been updated with polish and improvements to make your adventure smoother and even more fun. Whether it’s slaying pesky imps, gearing up with new armor, or exploring Barkhaven, things feel sharper than before. Your feedback has been great, and we’re working hard to keep refining Donna’s journey!

⚠️ Important Note
If you played the first version of the demo, we highly recommend starting a new game to avoid possible bugs or progression issues.

🎉 Festival Participation
We’re thrilled to announce that Donna: The Canine Quest is part of the No Time to Loot Festival! This is a fantastic chance for new players to discover Donna’s world.

💌 Wishlist & Support
Every wishlist truly helps us on this journey. If you haven’t yet, please consider adding Donna: The Canine Quest to your Steam wishlist and sharing it with your friends.

Thank you for playing and for joining us on this adventure. Donna still has many quests ahead, and we can’t wait to show you more!

– Raze Games
